title: Petition of the Massachusetts Highway Department, pursuant to G.L. c. 160, § 104, requesting that the Department of Public Utilities consent in writing to the construction of a highway-rail at-grade crossing, and to an exemption from the vertical clearance requirements of G.L. c. 160, § 98, for the construction of a temporary ramp and a viaduct, over railroad track at Widett Circle in South Boston, as part of the Central Artery (I-93)/Tunnel (I-90) Project.
